assumptions.statement: The repository provisional boundary is the only submission geometry basis; it is not an official redline and must be replaced as one complete topology when cleared official polygons arrive.
assumptions.impact: Every area, ratio, location, drawing and phase is an interim design-model output.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, density, setback, road, heritage, rail, municipal, fire and underground controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: These metrics remain unknown/null and all related spatial moves are conceptual suggestions.

assumptions.statement: Green and public-space layers are deliberate overlapping design systems derived from one provisional site topology.
assumptions.impact: Each ratio uses a unary union within its own layer before division by site area.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are non-parcel conceptual capacity prototypes and do not represent surveyed existing buildings or demolition decisions.
assumptions.impact: Only footprint geometry is recomputable; FAR, height, density and ownership conclusions are forbidden.

assumptions.statement: Generated architectural images depict a conceptual future experience and not observed site conditions.
assumptions.impact: They cannot support boundary, area, planning-control, heritage or implementation claims.
